name: story-to-handdrawn-video
title_zh: 中文故事稿进，20 种手绘风无声动画出
tagline_zh: 不用学动画，不用剪时间轴。故事稿或本地图片丢进去，出来就是铅笔日记或水彩分镜的 Remotion 成片。
tagline_en: No animation skills needed. Drop a story or local images, get a Remotion video in colored-pencil diary or.
desc_en: Convert Chinese story copy or ordered local images into a silent hand-drawn Remotion story video. Supports a locked user-approved colored-pencil diary default plus a built-in 20-style library covering doodle, crayon, line explainer, ink, watercolor, gouache, storybook, zine, whiteboard, and printmaking looks. Use when the user asks to generate, import, restyle, preview, or render a hand-drawn stor
why_zh: 内置 20 种画风库，但默认只走你点头的彩色铅笔日记风——风格是约束出来的，不是随机抽卡。
why_en: 20 built-in styles, but the default is a locked colored-pencil diary look you approve first. Style as constraint, not.
limit_zh: 只产无声视频，不生成配音或字幕轨；输入限中文故事稿或本地有序图片，不支持 URL 抓取；画风切换需重渲染。
limit_en: Silent video only—no audio or subtitle tracks. Accepts Chinese story text or ordered local images, not URLs. Style changes require full re-render.
unhide_note: 2026-09-04 店主指名，撤销旧的 hide（原因：早先门禁/判官）
